responsibility: This module provides the GNU Modula-2 coroutine and lightweight process runtime library: a PIM-style SYSTEM and executive layer that implements PROCESS primitives, context switching, scheduling, synchronization, and timed blocking for gm2 programs on native hosts. Its SYSTEM interface and implementation supply low-level coroutine creation, TRANSFER/IOTRANSFER, interrupt and I/O listening, and helper routines for compiler-emitted multiword BITSET operations; the Executive interface and implementation build on those primitives to manage process descriptors, ready and wait queues, semaphores, process lifecycle control, and scheduler/debug support; and the TimerHandler files add tick-driven sleeping, timed events, and round-robin task rotation through a dedicated timer process. Supporting files such as the keyboard LED interface and README document or expose small environment-specific utilities around this runtime, but the module’s core responsibility is the coroutine/process subsystem used by GNU Modula-2 rather than language parsing or code generation.
